evidence_items.explanation: This contemporaneous release reports a higher share using paid products, but use does not establish that the household pays. Its fieldwork period is also unclear, so February identifies the reported snapshot rather than a verified survey window.

unresolved_gaps: The 3% transaction measure has not been established as representative of the unspecified household population.
